name: Uken (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Uken village emblem in green: a ring with a small notch at the top enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Uken, a village in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 October 1966.

features.role: Uken village emblem — a ring with a small notch at the top enclosing a stylised character
